people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
translations.bsb: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
translations.kjv: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
translations.asv: and walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for an odor of a sweet smell.
